title: Snake dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4ee06a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1f9e4f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body2' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#57f07a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2fa85a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#2a4a5e'/>
  <!-- snake body coils, dancing S-curve -->
  <path d='M22 88 C 10 78, 20 66, 34 66 C 50 66, 44 52, 30 48 C 16 44, 18 30, 34 28 C 48 26, 56 36, 52 46'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#body1)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- belly stripes on lower coil -->
  <path d='M18 86 C 12 78, 20 70, 30 70' fill='none' stroke='#d8ff9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 66 C 46 64, 44 54, 34 50' fill='none' stroke='#d8ff9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 46 C 20 42, 22 32, 32 30' fill='none' stroke='#d8ff9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- upper body rising -->
  <path d='M52 46 C 50 38, 58 30, 66 26' fill='none' stroke='url(#body2)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#57f07a' transform='rotate(-18 72 22)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='18' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6fff92' transform='rotate(-18 82 18)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='3' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='1.4' fill='#0e3a22'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='17' r='2.6' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='17' r='1.2' fill='#0e3a22'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M76 25 Q 81 28 85 22' fill='none' stroke='#0e3a22' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- forked tongue -->
  <path d='M86 16 L 92 12' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M92 12 L 95 14' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M92 12 L 94 9' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little dancing arms / nubs -->
  <path d='M60 34 Q 54 30 52 24' fill='none' stroke='#57f07a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 24 L 48 22' stroke='#6fff92' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2.3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M89 46 L 89 36' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='52' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#ff9d3f'/>
  <path d='M18.6 52 L 18.6 43' stroke='#ff9d3f' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
